🧪 TransactPro — Pre-Launch Tester Guide

Thanks for helping us shake this out before we open it up to real agents. ~30 minutes start to finish.

What this is

TransactPro is a real-estate transaction-management app. You're testing the agent-side and the client-side flows on the live deployment. Anything you do here is on the real production system, but in a sandbox account you'll create yourself.

What you'll need

• A throwaway email you can read (Gmail trick: youremail+tptest@gmail.com goes to your normal inbox)
• A second email (or a friend's) to play "the client"
• A sample PDF — any PDF is fine; a receipt photo is helpful for one scenario
• ~30 minutes

⚠️ Read this first: If a step says "you should see X" and you don't, that's a bug — write it down with the step number. Also flag anything confusing, any blank screens, any button that does nothing, or anything where you had to refresh the page to see a change.
🚀 Start Testing →

Test scenarios (10 total)

Setup1. Register a new test brokerage
  1. Click Start Testing above (or just go to thelizteam.netlify.app).
  2. Click the Create Account tab.
  3. Fill in:
    • Account Type: Solo Agent
    • Brokerage Name: Tester Realty (or anything)
    • First/Last Name: your real name is fine
    • Email: your throwaway email (e.g. you+tptest@gmail.com)
    • Phone: any 10-digit number
    • State: Florida
    • Password: at least 8 characters
  4. Click Start Free Trial.
✅ Expected: Account is created and you're logged in. You should see the main dashboard within a couple seconds.
🚨 Flag if: You get a generic error, the page hangs, or you don't receive a welcome email at the throwaway address within ~1 minute.
Auth2. Log out and log back in
  1. Find the logout option (top right area).
  2. Confirm you're returned to the login screen.
  3. Log in again with the same credentials.
  4. Now click Forgot your password?, enter the same email, and check your inbox.
  5. Click the reset link from the email, set a new password, and log in with the new one.
✅ Expected: Reset email arrives within ~1 minute. The link works. New password lets you log in.
🚨 Flag if: No email arrives, the link is expired/broken, or the new password is rejected.
Agent3. Create a transaction manually
  1. From the dashboard, find New Transaction (or the + button).
  2. Fill in a property address (anything — "123 Test St, Orlando, FL 32801").
  3. Set status to Under Contract and pick any closing date 30+ days out.
  4. Save.
✅ Expected: The new transaction appears in your list and opens to the transaction detail view.
🚨 Flag if: Save silently fails, or required fields aren't clearly marked.
Agent4. Add a Buyer and a Seller
  1. Open the transaction you just created.
  2. Find the Parties section. Add a Buyer with your second email (or a friend's) — use a real address you can read.
  3. Add a Seller with another address you can read too.
  4. Save. Then look for an option like Send Welcome Emails and trigger it.
✅ Expected: Each party gets a welcome email with a "Client Portal" link. The agent UI shows them as added.
🚨 Flag if: An email doesn't arrive, or the email contains broken formatting / a missing logo / weird symbols.
Agent5. Upload a document
  1. Inside the transaction, go to the Documents tab.
  2. Upload any small PDF (under 10 MB).
  3. Try uploading something that's not a PDF or image (e.g., a .zip or a really large file > 50 MB) — it should be rejected with a clear message.
✅ Expected: Valid file uploads and appears in the doc list. Invalid file is rejected with a readable error like "File too large" or "File type not allowed".
🚨 Flag if: Upload silently fails, the page hangs, or rejection happens with no message.
Recent6. AI Receipt Scan (Expenses)

This feature was just rewired to use a background job queue. Worth testing carefully.

  1. Find the Expenses page in the app.
  2. Click New Expense.
  3. Take a photo of any receipt (or use a sample receipt image) and upload it.
  4. Wait — the message should say something like "AI reading receipt…" for ~5-15 seconds.
✅ Expected: After a few seconds, vendor / amount / date / category auto-fill from the receipt. You can edit them, then save.
🚨 Flag if: The status stays on "reading" forever, you get a timeout error, or the form never gets the AI-extracted values.
Recent7. CMA Calculator with AI comp extraction
  1. Open any transaction and look for the CMA or Pricing tool.
  2. Find a button like Upload Broker Synopses.
  3. Upload one or two PDFs (any MLS-style or broker-synopsis PDFs — even a generic one is fine, the AI will do its best).
  4. Wait — should say "extracting" / "AI extracting…" for ~10-30 seconds.
✅ Expected: AI fills in comp slots (address, sold price, beds/baths, etc.). Some fields may be blank if the AI couldn't read them — that's fine. You should be able to edit and continue.
🚨 Flag if: The "extracting" status hangs longer than ~60 seconds with no result, or the page crashes during extraction.
Recent8. Pre-Approval Letter upload + AI extract
  1. Open any transaction where the Buyer is using financing.
  2. Find the Pre-Approval card / section.
  3. Upload a PDF (any PDF will do for testing).
  4. The flow goes: uploading → "extracting…" → a review form with lender name, loan officer, amount, etc.
✅ Expected: Fields are pre-populated from the PDF. You can edit them and click Save. The pre-approval is then attached to the transaction.
🚨 Flag if: The extraction stage hangs, or the review form is missing fields.
Client9. Client-side test (use your 2nd email)
  1. Switch to your second email's inbox (the one used for the Buyer in Step 4).
  2. Open the welcome email. Click the Open Client Portal link.
  3. You should land in the Client Portal — set a password if prompted, log in.
  4. Try uploading a document the agent requested (anywhere there's a doc upload button).
  5. Try sending a chat message from the client side.
✅ Expected: Portal loads, shows the transaction details, and lets you upload + chat without errors.
🚨 Flag if: The link from the email goes to a broken page, the portal is empty, or chat messages don't send.
Edge10. Session-expired handling
  1. Stay logged in as the agent.
  2. Open your browser's DevTools → Application/Storage → Local Storage.
  3. Delete the tp_token entry (or just edit it to "invalid").
  4. Try to do anything in the app — click a transaction, refresh a list.
✅ Expected: You get an alert that your session expired and get sent back to the login screen. No silently-broken UI.
🚨 Flag if: The UI just freezes, shows weird errors, or never tells you you're logged out.

How to report what you find

For anything you flag, please include:

  • The step number (e.g. "Step 6, after uploading the receipt")
  • What you expected vs. what happened
  • Browser + device (e.g. "Chrome on iPhone" / "Safari on Mac")
  • If possible, a screenshot
📧 Send your notes to whoever invited you to test — text, email, or a quick note. Step number + what happened is enough.

Thank you! Catching bugs at this stage saves real agents pain later.
